core_obligations: Factorization: X -> S factors as a closed immersion into a quasi-compact open U of S.
Open disappears: V_i = preimage of U pulls back to X, so V_i = X_i eventually (descend-opens); the system becomes a system over U.
Closed part: eventually-closed-immersion makes X_i -> U a closed immersion for large i; conclude the immersion statement.
proof_roadmap: Factor through a qc open U.
descend-opens kills the open at a finite level.
difficulty_reason: Factorization into a closed immersion over a qc open + descend-opens makes the open disappear at a finite level + eventually-closed-immersion. Complete reduction chain.

compared.difference: The sibling descends immersions in the descent-of-properties situation (delivered as L30245); this lemma is the structure-morphism version with closed-immersion transitions. Different setups; both delivered.
